# Contributing

Thanks for your interest in improving this project.

## Before You Start

- Read [README.md](../README.md) for repository context.
- Review [plan/LABEL_STRATEGY.md](../plan/LABEL_STRATEGY.md), which is the single source of truth for labels and board inclusion rules.
- For documentation contributions, review [docs/README.md](../docs/README.md) and keep changes in UK English.

## Ways to Contribute

- Report bugs and gaps in documentation.
- Propose improvements to prompts, agents, workflows, and scripts.
- Submit fixes for scripts and documentation.

## Development Notes

- Keep changes focused and minimal.
- Avoid changing label names unless the strategy document is updated first.
- Follow existing structure and naming conventions.
- If you update docs, keep the internal/public split clear:
  - Internal contributor content belongs in [README.md](../README.md) and [plan/](../plan/)
  - End-user guidance belongs in [docs/](../docs/)

## Pull Request Checklist

- [ ] Change is scoped to a clear purpose
- [ ] Documentation updated when behaviour or workflow changes
- [ ] Label strategy alignment maintained
- [ ] No unrelated files were modified

## Questions

If you are unsure about direction, open an issue first to discuss the proposed change.
